hints.title: Reverse Alphabet Value Formula
hints.text: For any lowercase letter, its position from the end of the alphabet is given by code of z minus code of character plus one.

hints.title: Positional Weighting
hints.text: Each character contributes its reverse alphabet value multiplied by its one-indexed index in the string.

hints.title: Linear Accumulation
hints.text: Accumulate the weighted products in a single pass over the string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass computes character values and running sum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching an alphabet lookup table repeatedly is less direct than character arithmetic.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use ASCII arithmetic to compute alphabet ranks in constant time.
